items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Her son Danny Barker... I think Danny could paint that Tom Anderson plays for you. I think he remembers.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wish I had... Then Danny, show you a picture. No. With my uncle, Louis Artadar. No. They had big plumes. Big plumes. Like... Like... They do the wine. Like those French hats? Yeah, that's right. Like this? Yeah, a big plume up there. That's right. They even had a plume. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. What kind of uniform did they have? Well, the same type of uniform as the design. Uh-huh. But these... With hats with the plumes? Yeah. That would have been something to say. That was years ago. That was. I don't understand…

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Albert Nicholas is working with Red Allen, Pops Foster, Paul Barbarin, in Luis Russell’s band

ctx.x: Beating. Yeah, they’d be beating. Paul [Barbarin], he was the oldest. Paul would be beating. He was doing . . . After I joined Cab Calloway’s band, and Cozy Cole would stay in the dressing room all day, practicing ratamacues, flamamadiddles, flama­ ramadiddles, all them kind of drum movements, and I’d look at him. Everybody [? (inaudible)]. I heard my uncle. I had four uncles. All of them played drums. They was doing that [expletive deleted]. But doing it with a feeling, not just a military thing like Cozy was…
Did Lucien . . . Louis and Paul were very famous and well-known. Did Lucien ever record or did he stay in New Orleans?

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Paul Barbarin is my godfather. That's my mother's oldest brother... Paul Barbarin was the oldest brother who was a drummer... And from that, you can see the four boys beatin' around the house on drums

ctx.x: Now, what was your mother's maiden name...?
Rose. My mother's name was Ridley(?) Rose Barbarin, Paul Barbarin's sister.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: They called him Isidore, Isidore Barbarin.

ctx.x: They called him Isidore, Isidore Barbarin.
Are any of the Barbarin brothers living?
